name: Dirk Strider
source:
Dirk Strider is one of the four Alpha kids. [spoiler]He is the post-scratch incarnation of Dave Strider's adopted Bro and ectobiological father.[/spoiler]

He tends to brag when it comes to his achievements, especially involving robots. He seems to be a fan of horses, judging by his room being filled with horse and pony themed posters. It is inferred that he watches My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic, although he claims his interest is purely of academic nature. He is laid back and likes using intellectual analysis intermixed with ironic quips.

[From [url=https://mspaintadventures.fandom.com/wiki/Dirk_Strider]MSPA Wiki[/url]]
